# Adding a Till and Connecting a Device

# Point of Sale: Adding a Till and Connecting a Device

Each counter device that runs the till (a PC or tablet) is registered in OrderHub as a **POS terminal** at one of your store locations. You register it in OrderHub first, then enter its details once on the device itself.

---

## Step 1: Register the till in OrderHub

1. Click **Settings** and open the **Pixfizz** tab.
2. Click your website's card to open **Configure Website**.
3. Open the **Locations** tab and click **Edit** on the store location the till is in.
4. Open the **POS/Film Terminals** tab.
    * Note: If the location is brand new, save it first, then edit it again to see this tab.
5. Click **Add POS/Film Terminal**.
6. Fill in the details:

| Field | What to enter |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Terminal Name** | A name staff will recognise, e.g. "Front Counter". It shows at the top of the till. |
| **Device type** | **POS Terminal (till)**. (**Film Terminal** is for the Film Development App.) |
| **Receipt Printer** | The printer this till prints receipts on. Receipts always go to this printer. |
| **Cash Drawer** | The drawer this till uses. Shifts, floats and end-of-day reports belong to the drawer. Tills sharing one drawer share one shift. |
| **Payment Terminals** | Tick the card reader(s) this till can use and choose the **Default**. See **Card Payments with ProcessPoint**. |
| **Input mode** | **Keyboard & mouse (PC)**, or **Touch only (tablet)** for a tablet with no keyboard. |
| **UI Mode** | **Dark Mode** or **Light Mode**: which logo and brand colour the till shows. |
| **Active** | Leave on. |

7. Click **Create Terminal**.

![Create Terminal](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/08fda86f-b7e0-4893-ac47-ddd8db1e4f66.png)

* Note: If **Receipt Printer** shows "No printers found", make sure the PrintNode client is running on the PC you want to print from.

---

## Step 2: Copy the connection details

When the terminal is created, OrderHub shows **POS Terminal Created — Connect Your Device** with two details:

* **POS Terminal ID**
* **Auth Token**

![Terminal Credentials](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/eb1d0c6d-4851-4bb2-85de-912e666e4207.png)

* Note: **The Auth Token is only shown once.** Copy it now, or keep this window open while you connect the device. If you lose it, you can create a new one (see below).
* Note: Keep the token private. Anyone with it can open the till at this location.

---

## Step 3: Connect the device

1. On the counter device, open Pixfizz POS in the web browser.
2. The **OrderHub POS Terminal Setup** screen asks for:
    * **Terminal ID**: paste the **POS Terminal ID**.
    * **Device Token**: paste the **Auth Token**.
3. Tap **Save & continue**.

The till moves on to the **Staff login** screen, ready for staff to sign in with their PIN.

![POS Terminal Setup](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/1b6cb762-30d3-462e-ba77-6cd97199d7f1.png)

* Note: The details are only checked when the till first talks to OrderHub. If they're wrong, the till goes back to the setup screen. Check you copied both in full.

---

## Managing tills

From the **POS/Film Terminals** tab, each till's menu offers:

* **Edit**: change any of the details above. Changes reach the till within a few minutes.
* **Deactivate**: disconnects the till straight away. **Reactivate** brings it back.
* **Delete**: only possible for a till that has **never been used**. Once a till has taken sales, deactivate it instead.
* **Regenerate Auth Token** (in **Edit**, under **Danger Zone**): disconnects the device using the old token. Enter the new token on the device to reconnect.
